parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: The leg of the pliers is a steel component that forms one of the two handles used to apply force. It is elongated and ergonomically shaped for gripping.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits the user's hand force to the jaws for gripping or cutting objects.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg, allowing the jaws to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the pliers is the main structural part that includes the pivot joint and one of the gripping jaws. It is made of durable steel.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the central structure connecting both legs and houses the pivot mechanism, ensuring smooth operation and force transfer.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary relative to the pivot while the other leg moves, maintaining alignment and stability during use.
